subject: Post-call scope & commitment timeline for NovaHealth pilot
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lin <sophie.lin@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed scope & timeline for NovaHealth pilot

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap of what we heard and the proposal for next steps so we all have the same view.

Pain & goals
- Current clinical document search has ~45% irrelevant matches (you mentioned inaccurate sections and privacy redaction issues).
- Primary goal: increase retrieval precision and reduce clinician search time by ~30% during triage workflows.
- Compliance constraint: PHI must never leave NovaHealth VPC; private deployment required.

Proposed pilot scope
1) 2-week sandbox (private deployment) with a 1-node Dedicated instance for evaluation (subset of 1M records)
2) Integration points: FHIR-based index export + API for search reranking
3) Success metrics: precision@10 improvement >= 20%, avg search latency < 300ms

Stakeholders & decision path
- Sophie (Clinical informatics) — evaluation lead
- Arman Patel (Security, cc'd on replies) — security & procurement gate
- Lauren Bishop (Redwood, delivery PM) — pilot ops
- Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood, sales lead) — commercial approvals

Suggested milestones & dates
- Week of Aug 24: access & infra prep (security checklist + NDA)
- Aug 31 — Sep 4: data sync + verification
- Sep 7 — Sep 18: pilot run & measurement
- Sep 21: decision meeting (go/no-go)

Attachments: Nova_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (MVP scope & responsibilities)

Ask: Can you confirm the stakeholders and whether Aug 24 works for access provisioning? If you want, I can pull in our security engineer to handle the checklist—copying Vivek and Lauren who can coordinate.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Lin <sophie.lin@novahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Arman Patel <arman.patel@novahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed scope & timeline for NovaHealth pilot

Alex —

Appreciate the clear summary. High level all good and the dates look reasonable.
Couple clarifications:
- We need to add a pre-pilot risk assessment step for data minimization (my team will provide a sample export schema by Friday).
- Arman will own the security checklist; I copied him here.

Yes, Aug 24 for access prep works. We'll aim to have the export schema to you by 08/20.

One ask: can the sandbox run in our us-west-2 account? We prefer to keep data in-region.

Sophie
Director, Clinical Informatics
NovaHealth

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lin <sophie.lin@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Arman Patel <arman.patel@novahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed scope & timeline for NovaHealth pilot — MAP & next steps

Sophie —

Thanks — that's helpful. I've attached an editable Mutual Action Plan (xlsx) that maps owners, deliverables, and target dates. Key updates from your note:
- Adding 'data minimization assessment' as a pre-pilot milestone (target 08/20 for schema + 08/22 for sign-off)
- Confirming us-west-2 for sandbox; we'll provision Dedicated instance in that region.

Next steps we will take this week:
- Redwood: provision sandbox in us-west-2 (ETA 08/24), send security checklist draft (Vivek)
- NovaHealth: share export schema (Sophie) by 08/20
- NovaHealth security: Arman to review checklist and provide KMS/HSM constraints by 08/22

Link to MAP (editable): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XMAP_EXAMPLE
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9876 — Deal owner Vivek Kulkarni

Attachments: Nova_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, redwood-inference-brief.pdf

For the procurement thread, Arman — happy to sync separately once you've reviewed the checklist.

Best,
Alex

From: Arman Patel <arman.patel@novahealth.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed scope & timeline for NovaHealth pilot — MAP & next steps

Alex/Sophie,

Reviewed the checklist draft — looks good at a high level. Two immediate notes:
1) We'll need proof of SOC2 + architecture diagram showing isolation boundaries for the Dedicated node.
2) KMS integration is preferred; we cannot bring our own HSM for the pilot but need envelope encryption with customer-managed keys.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Aug 25 with my infra lead to walk through the network/team access. If you can confirm availability, I'll send the invite.

Thanks,
Arman
Security Engineering
NovaHealth
